scopeNotes: R07/R09 core fixtures do not qualify PDF/OCR/search adapters. R16 exercises implemented readiness/completeness eligibility gates; later publication/query orchestration remains with its owning items.
Manual-review-needed always blocks this default automatic gate; no review-receipt protocol or general lifecycle DependencyStore is invented.

OOM left a disposable schema; exact P2.5 digest/rights marker and isolated role grants identified it for cleanup.

First focused PHPStan invocation missed the workspace autoloader. With explicit bootstrap, runtime boundary annotations were corrected to describe checked input arrays. No ignore/baseline/disabled rule was added.
